sketches.mechanism: ARC weak references do not retain their object and are automatically set to nil when the last strong reference disappears.
sketches.resonance: What refuses to possess also cannot keep; it remembers only until the beloved leaves.

sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a nil channel blocks forever rather than returning a value or an error.
sketches.resonance: A wait addressed to no passage is still a wait, but nothing can ever answer it.

sketches.mechanism: Lazy evaluation permits a self-recursive bottom value to exist harmlessly when it is never demanded.
sketches.resonance: An infinite hurt can remain inside the program as long as no one touches it.
